note: YC hint confirmed: Bitrise (bitrise.io) is YC W17, 'the first Hungarian company accepted into Y Combinator', matching the card's domain. Founded 2014 in Budapest, Hungary; now remote-first with offices in SF, Boston, Tokyo, London. Raised Series A ($3.2M, 2017, led by Open Ocean, w/ YC & Fiedler Capital), Series B ($20M, 2019, led by Partech), Series C ($60M, Nov 2021, led by Insight Partners), total ~$100M. Acquired Outlyer (2019, monitoring/analytics) and Flare.Build (2022, Bazel remote caching/build backend) — these are Bitrise-as-acquirer, not Bitrise being acquired. Still independent/private as of check date; no revenue figures found.
